corrected_content.problem: The vector $\overrightarrow{AB}$ has magnitude $7$. Which of the following is a unit vector that is parallel to $\overrightarrow{AB}$?
corrected_content.worked_solution:
A unit vector in the direction of $\overrightarrow{AB}$ is obtained by dividing by its magnitude:

$$
\frac{\overrightarrow{AB}}{|\overrightarrow{AB}|}=\frac17\overrightarrow{AB}.
$$

Its magnitude is $\frac17(7)=1$.
